caption:
Pretending you've already arrived? Growth is meant to show. (1 Timothy 4:15–16 devotional)

Maturity isn't a hidden finish line you pretend you've crossed. Paul says let your progress be seen by all — it's a direction that visibly grows. The pretense of “arrived” is what stalls you.
